test_title: PYST 18: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Dare Square' Motorcycle Expedition flagged off in January 2025.

 
• The expedition was launched by the Eastern Naval Command as part of INS Ranvijay’s 37th anniversary celebrations.
 
• The rally aims to promote mental health awareness, road safety and maritime heritage among youth through outreach activities.
 
• It was conducted in collaboration with the Indian Air Force and covered northeastern states of India.
 
• The rally culminates at the Dogra Regimental Centre in Ayodhya, highlighting the naval affiliation with the Dogra Regiment.

Which of the above statements are correct?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only 1, 2 and 4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 'Dare Square' Motorcycle Expedition was launched by the **Eastern Naval Command** as part of the celebrations for INS Ranvijay’s 37th anniversary.
 
• The primary objectives of the rally included **promoting mental health awareness, road safety, and maritime heritage** among the youth through outreach activities.
 
• The expedition was conducted in collaboration with the Indian Air Force, enhancing inter-service cooperation and synergy.
 
• The rally culminated at the **Dogra Regimental Centre in Ayodhya**, reflecting the naval affiliation with the Dogra Regiment and paying tribute to this association.
 
• Statement 3 is incorrect since the expedition did not specifically cover the northeastern states of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Eastern Naval Command (ENC):**

 
 
• Headquartered in Visakhapatnam, the ENC is one of the three operational commands of the Indian Navy.
 
• It plays a critical role in safeguarding India's eastern seaboard and maritime interests in the Bay of Bengal.
 
 
 
• **INS Ranvijay:**
 
 
• INS Ranvijay is a Rajput-class destroyer commissioned into the Indian Navy in 1987.
 
• It is equipped with advanced weaponry and systems, making it a key asset in naval operations.
 
 
 
• **Dogra Regiment:**
 
 
• The Dogra Regiment is one of the oldest infantry regiments of the Indian Army, known for its valor and distinguished service.
 
• The affiliation of naval units with army regiments fosters inter-service camaraderie and mutual respect.
 
 
 
• **Mental Health Awareness in India:**
 
 
• Mental health is a significant concern in India, with initiatives like campaigns and outreach programs aimed at reducing stigma and promoting awareness.
 
• Organizations such as the National Mental Health Programme (NMHP) work to improve mental health services in the country.
 
 
 
• **Road Safety Initiatives:**
 
 
• India has launched programs like the National Road Safety Policy to reduce road accidents and enhance safety awareness.
 
• Public campaigns and enforcement of traffic laws are critical in addressing the high rate of road-related fatalities.
